issues.problem: A flagged SRM should be treated as a pipeline problem regardless of size; calling imbalances 'harmless' invites ignoring a real alarm.
issues.replacement: with very large traffic even tiny imbalances become statistically significant; still treat a flagged SRM as a pipeline problem and look at the size of the gap and its cause as well as p.

issues.replacement: with 100k users, treatment having 2.4% more users than control (50.6% vs 49.4% of the total) is not small.
